lessons.title: UK could see 10 days without rain after 'wettest week in two years'
lessons.title_zh: 英國經歷「兩年來最潮濕的一週」後可能迎來連續十天無雨

paragraphs.en: The United Kingdom could experience up to ten consecutive days without rain following an unsettled end to October. Recently, the country was hit by back-to-back storms named Austen and Boelo, which were the first named storms of the season. These turbulent weather systems brought heavy rainfall, power cuts, and travel disruption. According to the Environment Agency, the rain from these storms, combined with another low-pressure system on Monday, resulted in the wettest week England has seen in two years.
paragraphs.zh: 在歷經十月底不穩定的天氣後，英國可能迎來長達十天沒有降雨的日子。最近，名為奧斯汀（Austen）和博埃洛（Boelo）的接連風暴襲擊了該國，這是本季首批被命名的風暴。這些混亂的天氣系統帶來了豪雨、停電以及交通混亂。根據英國環境署（Environment Agency）的說法，這些風暴帶來的降雨加上週一的另一個低氣壓系統，造成了英格蘭兩年來最潮濕的一週。

paragraphs.en: Following this stormy period, a strong area of high pressure is moving in, bringing a prolonged spell of calm and dry conditions across most regions. Even though heavy rain is not in sight, persistent mist and fog will remain a major feature during the mornings. Some of these dense fog patches will be slow to clear, potentially causing reduced visibility and disruptions for travelers before brighter skies finally emerge.
paragraphs.zh: 在度過這段暴風雨時期之後，一股強大的高氣壓正在移入，為大多數地區帶來持續且乾燥穩定的天氣。儘管目前看不到豪雨的跡象，但持續的薄霧和濃霧仍將是早晨的主要特徵。其中一些濃霧消散得相當緩慢，在轉為晴朗天空之前，可能會降低能見度並給旅客帶來困擾。

paragraphs.en: For people heading out to celebrate Halloween on Saturday evening, conditions should remain largely dry under clear skies with light winds. However, a few scattered showers could put a dampener on events in the Western Isles of Scotland. As darkness falls, temperatures are expected to edge lower over the coming days, creating a noticeably chilly feel during the nights and early mornings.
paragraphs.zh: 對於在週六晚間出門慶祝萬聖節的人來說，天空晴朗且風力微弱，天氣應大致保持乾燥。然而，少數零星的陣雨可能會讓蘇格蘭西部群島（Western Isles of Scotland）的活動掃興。隨著夜幕降臨，未來幾天的氣溫預計將逐漸下降，在夜間和清晨帶來明顯的寒意。

paragraphs.en: Experts predict that this settled pattern will last into early November, but a shift could occur around the middle of the month. Signs indicate that the high pressure may loosen its hold, allowing low-pressure systems from the Atlantic to approach. This change could bring wetter and windier weather back to the UK. Furthermore, the intensifying El Niño climate event in the Pacific Ocean has been linked to wetter and stormier conditions during late autumn and early winter.
paragraphs.zh: 專家預測這種穩定的天氣型態將持續到十一月初，但在月中左右可能會出現轉變。跡象顯示高氣壓可能會減弱其控制，使得來自大西洋的低氣壓系統得以接近。這項轉變可能會為英國再次帶來更加潮濕且多風的天氣。此外，太平洋地區正在增強的聖嬰現象（El Niño），也與深秋及初冬更潮濕、更多風暴的天氣有所關聯。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的非限定子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 使用逗號加上關係代名詞「which」形成非限定子句，補充說明先行詞「back-to-back storms」。
grammar.example: Recently, the country was hit by back-to-back storms named Austen and Boelo, which were the first named storms of the season.
grammar.focus: which were the first named storms of the season

grammar.explain: 由現在分詞「bringing」引導分詞構句，修飾主要子句，表示伴隨產生的結果。
grammar.example: Following this stormy period, a strong area of high pressure is moving in, bringing a prolonged spell of calm and dry conditions across most regions.
grammar.focus: bringing a prolonged spell of calm and dry conditions across most regions

grammar.point: 現在完成式被動語態 (Present Perfect Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 使用「has been + 過去分詞」表示某事物已經被發現與另一情況有所關聯。
grammar.example: Furthermore, the intensifying El Niño climate event in the Pacific Ocean has been linked to wetter and stormier conditions during late autumn and early winter.
